general.question: What is VideoFly?
general.answer: VideoFly is a cutting-edge AI video generation platform that allows you to transform text and images into high-quality videos in minutes. Powered by advanced models like Sora 2 and Veo 3.1, it enables creators to bring their visions to life without expensive equipment.

commercial.question: Can I use the videos for commercial purposes?
commercial.answer: Yes! Videos generated with our Pro and Team plans come with a full commercial license, allowing you to use them in your marketing, social media, and commercial projects.

aiModels.question: Which AI models do you use?
aiModels.answer: We provide text-to-video, multi-reference, and first/last-frame video generation.

credits.question: How does the credit system work?
credits.answer: You use credits to generate videos. Different models and video durations consume different amounts of credits. You can purchase credit packs or subscribe to a monthly plan to receive a steady supply of credits at a discount.

refund.question: Do you offer refunds?
refund.answer: We offer a satisfaction guarantee. If a generated video fails due to a system error, we will refund the credits. For subscription payments, please contact our support team within 7 days if you're not satisfied.

support.question: How can I get support?
support.answer: Our dedicated support team is available 24/7. You can reach us via the contact form on our website or by emailing support@videofly.app.
